title: mkfs() privsep entrypoint discards 'label' argument — passes None to unprivileged_mkfs
detail: The privsep entrypoint `mkfs(fs, path, label=None)` calls `unprivileged_mkfs(fs, path, label=None)` with the label hardcoded to None instead of forwarding the `label` parameter. Any caller that passes a volume label to the privileged `mkfs` will have it silently ignored. Change the call to `unprivileged_mkfs(fs, path, label=label)`.
